meta.name: q2q3_landscape
meta.notes: Compustat-only universe; industry bar = unweighted mean of plotted firm means

decomposition.method: Sequential fixed effects (year, then industry, then firm), adjusted R-squared gains; operating ROA winsorized at 1%/99%; firms = whole companies.

mcgahan_porter.source: McGahan and Porter (1997), Strategic Management Journal; US business segments, 1981-94.

data.rule: US-incorporated companies with a traded price; >= 12 firms with >= 3 valid years, FY2021-2025; assets >= $1000m in 2024 dollars
data.source_line: Source: Compustat via WRDS. US-incorporated public companies; operating return on assets, average FY2021–25.
